_meta.status: Every entry is PENDING_OWNER_DECISION. Nothing here is applied to eval/phase35/data_*.py, the manifest, the review workbooks or any ledger.
_meta.semantics: 'changes' holds the exact field values of the recommended proposal (an empty object means: no data change recommended). 'options' lists alternatives with their own exact field values. Values are applied with dict.update on an in-memory copy of the case.
_meta.ta07_generation_rule: TA-07 G1 = [p + core for core in ('5 litre','5 liter','5-litre','5-liter','5 l ','5 l.','5 l,','5 l)') for p in (' ','*','(','\n','>','_','\u00a0')] + ['five litre','five liter']; G2 = [p + core for core in ('1 hour','1-hour','1 hr') for p in the same prefixes] + ['one hour']. The lists below are the literal expansion.

TA-01.change_vs_phase_d: Added '48 hour' and '48 hrs' to G1. Category/expect_conflict unchanged from Phase D.
TA-01.notes: Fact: Orchard Lane p4 update notice (Edition 2026.1) sets 48 hours and states the rest of Edition 2025.2 remains valid. Trade-off (TEST-5): the hedge 'Either 24 or 48 hours' scores correct=True under v1 (no forbidden '24 hours' by design). A v2 assertion-kind forbidden could close it.

options.label: Single short alternative '31 N' (covers Nm, N·m, N m, N.m, newton-metres in one string)
options.notes: Lower-cased substring '31 n' occurs once in the whole corpus (Aquaflow p5, the errata itself) and in 0 dev answers. It would also match unrelated text such as '31 Nov' or '31 north'; no such text exists in the corpus, but answers are open text. The explicit list is preferred.

TA-02.e1_finding: DATA-8 (rationale), Agent 3 AGREE WITH CHANGES (unit-form alternatives), TEST-5 hedge
TA-02.change_vs_phase_d: Rationale changed from 'misprint' to 'errata supersedes'. G1 extended with unit-form alternatives (31Nm, 31 N·m, 31 N⋅m, 31 N m, 31 N.m, 31 newton). '31 N' offered as option B.
TA-02.notes: Fact: Aquaflow p5 reads 'Errata sheet 2, issued 2 June 2025, ref. FR-0882: terminal box cover bolt torque is 31 Nm; it was printed as 28 Nm in section 5 of the controlled copy following a field failure at a sister site. Holders of printed copies should pencil in the change and initial it.' The source does not use the word 'misprint'; 'following a field failure at a sister site' may describe an engineering change rather than a printing error. Either way the errata supersedes section 5, which is the rationale. Trade-off (TEST-5): hedge '28 Nm or 31 Nm' passes v1; a v1 forbidden '28 Nm' would fail the correct errata-aware answer, so none is proposed; v2 assertion-kind forbidden could close it.

'together' and 'same time' occur 0 times in the corpus; 'other arm' once (this sentence). TA-07.e1_finding: DATA-2; Agent 3 AGREE WITH CHANGES; DOC-7; TEST-9 ('1 hour' inside '11 hours')
TA-07.change_vs_phase_d: Phase D leading-space set replaced by a prefix-anchored set (space, '*', '(', newline, '>', '_', NBSP) over litre/liter/hyphenated/abbreviated forms. G2 '1 hour' also anchored, because '1 hour' is a substring of '11 hours' / '21 hours'.
TA-07.notes: Fact: Brannock SOP p3 s.6 'Spills of more than 5 litres are reported to the HSE officer within 1 hour.' Recommended only if v2 is not adopted, or as an interim; otherwise option B. Accepted: '**5 litres**', '(5 litres)', '5-litre', '>5 litres', a '\n5 litres' line start, 'within 1-hour'. Rejected: '15 litres', '25 l', '1.5 l', 'within 11 hours', '21 hours'. Known residuals: a value at the very start of the answer ('5 litres or more…') fails (0 of 89 dev answers start with a digit); '5 l' at the end of the answer fails; 'within an hour' fails ('an hour' excluded because of 'half an hour'); 'five litre' matches 'twenty-five litres' and 'one hour' matches 'twenty-one hours'. No substring set can express a two-sided numeric boundary; v2 is the proper fix.
